run_process_wiki_extractor_links: run the script to extract links from a WikiExtractor output file and save results as a pickle file
extract_links_via_xml_parsing: extract hyperlinks from Wikipedia documents by parsing anchor tags with xml.etree.ElementTree and collecting href and text attributes
extract_links_via_regex: extract hyperlinks from Wikipedia documents using a compiled regex pattern to match anchor tags and capture href and text
parse_wiki_extractor_doc_blocks: parse WikiExtractor output by iterating over lines and grouping content between doc start and end tags into document objects
dump_parsed_links_to_pickle: dump the parsed document objects containing url, lines, xml links, and regex links into a pickle file for downstream use
